messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a small schema change for orders tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC. Adds a partial index on (user_id, status) to speed up recent query patterns.
Alex: Proposed window: start 02:00, dual-write begin 02:05, switch reads 02:45, complete by 03:00. Any objections?
Maria: I can own DB side. Estimate index build ~20–30m if we build concurrently, backfill another ~30m if we need to populate the partial index.
Jordan: I’ll schedule the deploy and coordinate app-side dual-write. Can we make the dual-write idempotent and feature-flagged?
Alex: Yes — feature flag will gate read switch. plan is: app writes to both schemas during dual-write, then after smoke we flip reads under flag.
Priya: Oncall here — can we limit the window to 45m instead of an hour? nights in APAC start to overlap.
Maria: We can. If we do concurrent index build and reduce backfill batch size it should fit. Suggest backfill batch size 5000 rows/min.
Jordan: Sounds good. I’ll set up a canary deploy to 10% of traffic at 02:30, health checks for 5m, then 50% at 02:38, full switch at 02:45 if green.
Alex: Rollback plan: flip feature flag back to single-write, stop backfill jobs, drop the new index if we need to revert (dangerous, but stashed SQL ready).
Maria: SQL snippets below for quick rollback and check:
```sql
-- check index existence
SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename='orders' AND indexname='idx_orders_user_status_partial';
-- quick drop (only if safe)
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_orders_user_status_partial;
```
Jordan: App smoke checklist I'll run:
- ping /health on canary 
- run a sample query that hit the new index path (see test query in runbook)
- check 95th latency on orders endpoints
- confirm no errors in logs (search for `dual-write-fail`)
I’ll post the smoke results in this thread.
Priya: Monitoring hooks: add a short-term alert for errors > 0.5% on orders read/write, and DB replication lag > 3s. I’ll be watching.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline: https://ci.internal.redwood/changes/4872 deployed to staging green -> ready for prod runway.
Alex: Who will actually click the big red deploy button? @Jordan?
Jordan: Yep, I’ll trigger. I’ll also leave a note in the runbook with exact timestamps and the rollback SQL.
Maria: One more: read-replica catch-up check 02:20 — run `SELECT now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()` and make sure < 2s. If >2s we postpone index build by 15m.
Alex: Great. If no objections I'll lock window and add this to schedule. :thumbsup:
Priya: :eyes: looks good from me. Oncall available.
Jordan: Locking window in calendar now and posting runbook link.
Alex: Thanks all — will post final go/no-go 01:30 UTC tomorrow.
